title: Nintendo Switch Repair
subtitle: Not charging, no signs of life at all.
description: Last week, my kids' Nintendo Switch completely died and refused to charge. I found a short on the M92T36 power management IC, micro-soldered a replacement chip, and now it's working again

WhatsApp Image 2026-09-19 at 18.17.46.jp: My Yojock meter isn't powering on, which confirms the Switch motherboard is drawing zero power.
WhatsApp Image 2026-09-19 at 18.32.39.jp: The M92T36 is the power management chip for the Nintendo Switch.
IMG_018_ 2026-09-19 at 18.55.55.png: A dead short on the capacitor across pins 8 (GND) and 9 (VBUS) confirms the M92T36 IC is internally shorted to ground."
Screenshot 2026-09-19 at 18.25.16.png: I ordered a brand new M92T36 chip from MBI Tech Parts, a family owned supplier based in Donegal, Ireland.
WhatsApp Image 2026-09-19 at 18.10.10.jp: I tested the battery with a multimeter and found that while the charge is very low, it is still healthy.
